- Crowdworkers evaluate responses for conversational attributes on each turn and provide an overall engagingness score.
Evaluators rate each model response on knowledgeability, factual correctness, engagingness, consistency, and provide an overall engagingness score.

The crowdworkers are asked to evaluate their partner's responses for conversational attributes, in particular knowledgeability, factual (in)correctness, engagingness and consistency. On each turn of the conversation the crowdworker is asked to check all attribute boxes that apply to the last turn. At the end of the conversation, an additional question collects an overall engagingness score (out of 5) for their speaking partner.

changes_made.explanation: Condensed guideline descriptions and normalized criteria names. Removed '(in)' from factual correctness for consistency. Separated overall engagingness as a guideline element rather than evaluation criterion.

overall_notes: The paper clearly addresses NLG (dialogue generation) with both automatic and human evaluations. The extraction was largely accurate but contained some duplicates and minor inconsistencies. The paper focuses on internet-augmented dialogue generation using search queries and retrieved knowledge to enhance response quality.
